question: The normal systolic and diastolic pressure in humans is __________, respectively.
solution:
The correct answer is __**120 and 80 mm of Hg**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **120 and 80 mm of Hg** are the **normal systolic and diastolic pressures in humans**, respectively.
 
• Systolic pressure (**120 mm of Hg**) is the **pressure in the arteries** when the **heart beats**.
 
• Diastolic pressure (**80 mm of Hg**) is the **pressure in the arteries** when the **heart rests between beats**.
 
• Maintaining normal blood pressure is crucial for health as high or low blood pressure can lead to various health issues.
 
• Regular monitoring and a healthy lifestyle can help maintain normal blood pressure levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Blood pressure** is measured in **millimeters of mercury** (mm of Hg) and recorded with two numbers.
 
• The **first number** (systolic pressure) measures the pressure in your blood vessels when your heart beats.
 
• The **second number** (diastolic pressure) measures the pressure in your blood vessels when your heart rests between beats.
 
• High blood pressure, or **hypertension**, can lead to serious health problems such as **heart disease, stroke, and kidney disease**.
 
• Low blood pressure, or **hypotension**, can cause **dizziness and fainting **and may indicate underlying health issues.
 
• Factors influencing blood pressure include diet, exercise, stress, and genetics.
